authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. The Local Planning Authority dataset contains administrative boundaries for England LPAs and reports 337 authorities; it can identify the LPA responsible for an area. A bounded window of at most 50 records/identifier candidates was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA/local-plan-boundary reference or name, LAD/statistical-geography reference/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore choosing any LPA boundary would be an unsupported guess. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
